limits: Directory absence is qualified to checked source revisions and sheets; not a claim of dataset-wide unavailability.
Script completion means all candidates have a disposition, not all buildings have detailed models.
Source structures include podiums and canopies; tallying parts is not architectural completeness.
No automatic threshold relaxation, source height changes, viewer replacement or source-ID suppression.
